description: Elections Commission - Declare that Mahendiran Pireman as a member of the Vadamaradchi South-west Pradesiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Vadamaradchi South West Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral procedures, candidate nominations, and the declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy created by resignation. This falls squarely within the Elections category (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections.
